references.retrieval: Actual UTF-8 C++ source downloaded and inspected; raw.githubusercontent.com failed TLS, jsDelivr source fetch succeeded.
references.observed_semantics: BlackLevel::read reads default black_level=4096 (64 in 10 bits scaled to 16 bits), independent red/green/blue tuning, optional analogue-gain PWL functions. prepare writes RGB BlackLevelStatus into metadata.
references.used_for: Mature ISP design reference for channel-dependent black offsets applied before later ISP processing; no source copied into original RTL.
references.differences: The inspected file is control/tuning, not a RAW subtraction pixel oracle. It exposes one green value and 16-bit-scaled tuning with optional gain dependence. This RTL distinguishes Gr/Gb, uses native 8/10/12-bit integers, no gain PWL, and adds host-selected optical-black ROI same-frame estimation plus target pedestal. No full libcamera pixel-bit equivalence is claimed.

numerical_reference: Independent Python Fraction mean rounding and exact integer saturation; no copied RTL state-machine emulation.
